dedupe_keys.name: 2019 nygrid data for unit commitment and economic dispatch simulation

description: This data set provides inputs for unit commitment and economic dispatch simulation of the New York State power system for 2019. It was published on Zenodo in March 2025 by Han Shu and Siva Visvesvaran. The NYGrid folder holds thermal generator data, including type, capacity, ramping rates and operating cost, taken from the open NYGrid representation of the New York State grid by Liu and colleagues, based on capacity installed in 2019. The time series folder holds correlated wind, solar and load scenarios for the NYISO system in 2019, generated from probabilistic forecasts developed in the ARPA-E PERFORM programme with a method that captures dependence over time while matching each variable's distribution: day-ahead forecasts at hourly resolution for unit commitment and hour-ahead forecasts at five-minute resolution for economic dispatch. Coverage is New York State. The data are a single zipped archive of about 600 MB, downloadable from Zenodo under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. Caveats: the scenarios are synthetic, and the network model itself comes from the NYGrid source. Simulation uses are stochastic unit commitment, dispatch under renewable uncertainty and reserve studies. Related records: data-arpa-e-grid-optimization-competition also serves ARPA-E grid research.
